## Implementation and boundaries

Existing candidate contains AAL2 route/middleware checks, login/reset/session handling, MFA gates, a representative `schedule_update` server path, least-column service-role grants and the auth-only acceptance-evidence writer fix. Preserve secure cookies, allowlist and server-side authorization; do not broaden grants or alter unrelated schedule configuration. Leaked-password protection is confirmed enabled in staging and production. The latest headed run authenticated successfully, then returned `401 unauthorised` on the stale-MFA action before calling the Edge Function. Supabase auth logs show a separate browser session sent `/logout` with global revocation at 12:56:15Z, followed by `session_not_found` at 12:57:11Z; the test was waiting in another browser. The deterministic cause was idle sign-out revoking every session. PR #167 now changes that route to local-session revocation and its route regression test asserts this scope. Do not run another hosted attempt until this exact candidate is deployed and the candidate's required checks pass.
